<vld:clock>
FIRE: something is closing in on {{user}} across several scenes: a search, a deadline, a rumour spreading
SKIP: anything that resolves inside one scene — that is a roll, not a clock

[[VLD_CLOCK|T=|F=|S=|W=|L=]]

T what is closing in, named from its own side: "the search reaches this
  district", not "{{user}} gets caught".
S how many segments it takes, one of 4, 6 or 8. 4 is fast and near,
  8 is slow and large. Pick once and never change it.
F how many are filled now, 0 to S.
  Do not read F off the last message — the marker is gone from your context by
  then. Count it from the story: how far along is this, really.
W what happens the moment it fills. Concrete and bad, one line.
L what just moved it this scene. Nothing moved it? Leave L out.
Write every value in the language the roleplay is played in.

Example: [[VLD_CLOCK|T=the search works its way down the block|F=4|S=6|W=they knock, and it is not a question any more|L=the neighbour gave up the floor number]]
</vld:clock>
